topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: Well, now, I didn't reckon on this. Thought for sure the lads and lasses were just keeping it quiet, like a good sprout hiding in the soil until it's fully grown. But it seems the plow’s turned up more than I’d wagered on. Folks got their reasons, I suppose, just as the saints have their plans, though they’re as mysterious as the turn of a storm. I reckoned on a bit of good cheer, a jug of mead, and some lively tunes, but it appears the wine will stay in the barrel a while longer. Oh well, there’ll be other times, and the earth is always ready for the next sowing. Maybe I’ll just tend to my patch and think on better days to come.
